wheelHint: Scroll or use arrow keys to turn pages
dropHint: Drop a ZIP, CBZ, 7z, RAR or another archive here.
repairHint: Only filenames in the copy change; image data is not recompressed. Choose the original encoding and check the preview. Valid UTF-8 names are preserved.
repairMore: Preview shows the first 100 names; all entries are converted when saved.
E_DECODE_NAME: Cannot decode a name with this encoding. Try another encoding.
E_SAME_FILE: Choose a new path; the original archive cannot be overwritten.
E_CHANGED: The archive changed. Preview it again.
E_NEW_FILE: Cannot create the copy. Choose a new, unused filename.
E_SOURCE: Unsupported source. Mount the SMB share in your operating system first.
E_UNREACHABLE: File unavailable. Check the path or remount the share.
E_FILE: Choose a ZIP or CBZ file
E_NO_IMAGES: No supported images in this archive (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
E_BYTES: Image exceeds the 96 MiB decompression limit
E_READ: Image read failed; the archive may have a checksum error
E_PIXELS: Image exceeds the 24 megapixel safety limit
createHint: Password is optional. Choose a new output name.
extractHint: Extract into a new folder. Enter a password for encrypted archives.
E_ARCHIVER: Cannot process this archive. It may be damaged or unsupported.
E_UNSAFE_ARCHIVE: Archive contains unsafe paths or links.
E_BUSY: Wait for the current job or cancel it.
E_EXISTS: Output already exists. Choose a new name.
E_OUTPUT: Cannot write output. Keep output outside the source folder.
E_INPUT: Choose files in the same folder, or one folder.
